CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content presentation/access was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set for red), its presentation (coordinate assignment), and a separate origin/status line are all present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to a content's organization/access; command/estimate markers alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents and attributes (color) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are given separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing identity from status/access/origin.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate assignments).
